mentions.name: CLI-first style-emulating video editor
mentions.description: A CLI-first, GUI-second video editor that can emulate the style of any filmmaker or film it is directed at, and also works as a basic desktop video/audio editing suite.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A CLI first, GUI second video editor that can emulate the style of any filmmaker or film you direct at it.

It was surprisingly easy to build.

It's also just a half decent basic video/audio editing suite that works on the desktop.
mentions.author: bparsons
